name: GradientText
description: Text filled with a gradient that keeps flowing, for a short headline or a highlighted word. The words stay real text.

colors.description: Colours of the gradient, any CSS colours. Two or more. Each should be readable on the page by itself.

duration.description: Seconds for the colours to flow once around.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

requirements: Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and the effect can also be shown still with the rdm-still class
The default colours each meet 4.5:1 against the page in light and dark; check your own
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode it is drawn in the system text colour with no effect
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code

use_when: A headline or one emphasised word on a marketing page
anti_patterns: Gradients with a very light colour, which disappears on a light page
